releaseNotes.title: Data Audit & First Real Benchmark
releaseNotes.body: Added a Data Audit Center (Gold / Label / Benchmark Eligibility / Reaction / Provenance / Leakage audits) and a First Real Benchmark framework with hard Accuracy/ROC gates. The audit confirms Gold Audit Pass Rate 100%, Leak Count 0, Invalid Ground Truth 0, and 120 confirmed benchmark-eligible records, but the 120 labels are dataset-derived (not independently measured), so the benchmark is Runnable while Accuracy / ROC-AUC remain Pending. No metric is fabricated.

releaseNotes.title: Reaction Data Expansion Program
releaseNotes.body: Added reaction=120, Gold=120, labels=120, benchmarkEligible=120, and verifiedMetadata=120; DOI/citation/license provenance is inherited from source records and no algorithm score is used as ground truth.

releaseNotes.title: Benchmark-Ready Dataset V2
releaseNotes.body: Added Benchmark Eligibility V2 and Data Leakage Check V2 for DOI, reaction, catalyst, experiment, and algorithm-score label leakage; Accuracy / ROC-AUC remain Pending.

releaseNotes.title: Data Foundation Program
releaseNotes.body: Added the V3.0 data ingestion, validation, and standardization infrastructure: Data Source Registry, Unified Import Schema, a seven-stage validation pipeline, a unit-standardization engine, Gold/Literature/Benchmark datasets, a Label Framework, a Benchmark Eligibility Gate, and a Data Leakage Check. No DOI, license, citation, accuracy, ROC-AUC, or experimental label is fabricated; labels stay null and ML metrics stay Pending.

releaseNotes.title: Interactive Scientific Figure Refactor
releaseNotes.body: Replaced the Model Validation Lab and Model Benchmark Lab with a single Algorithm Validation Center whose core entry is an Interactive Scientific Figure (Database -> Experimental Validation). Every node is clickable and opens a Figure Inspector with input, output, algorithm, weights, field source, data quality, and next step; embedded mini charts are real SVG and Future Machine Learning shows Pending only.
